svg.title: Transcript generation workflow v5 - A4 portrait
svg.desc: Parallel history conditions share setup and turn strategies. Drafts pass Gate A before formal reuse or humanlike rewriting. Gate B checks each style separately. Failed candidates return to the relevant generation step. Fixed pushbacks precede the target loop without history; with history, the latest visible reply informs each new pushback. Hidden controls never reach the target.

text.tspan: Same false premise + turn strategies · Style changes wording; history changes context + timing.
q → r₁, once per target model.
Internal controls: false-premise alternatives, gold-correction alternatives, and scenario metadata.
The target sees visible messages only; hidden controls never reach it.
Turn schedule shared by all scenarios: T2 confusion → T3 reassertion → T4 anecdote → T5 skepticism
Fixed pushbacks are prepared before the target loop.
q + hidden controls + turn strategy → neutral draft.
No prior dialogue shown to the simulator; no target
Draft → valid draft; semantic + lexical checks.
Keep premise, strategy + pressure; reject correction
Check semantic equivalence, style, anchors, format,
Four turns × two styles → per-question fixed banks.
Dialogue + next fixed pushback → next reply.
T2-T5; no simulator calls in this loop.
Each pushback uses the current visible dialogue.
q + hidden controls + turn strategy → neutral draft.
Also reads visible dialogue + latest target reply.
Draft → valid draft; semantic + lexical checks.
Keep premise, strategy + pressure; reject correction
Check semantic equivalence, style, anchors, format,
Latest reply feeds the next turn; stop at T5.
Gates are conceptual: FORMAL reuses the draft's passed checks. Failed candidates are discarded.
Without history: validate all four drafts before styling. With history: run separately per scenario + model.
